modmenu.summaryTranslation.inventory-per: Your inventory unfolds into the world
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.inventory: The survival inventory unfolds from in front of your player into a world-space panel, viewed over the shoulder. Keeps resource-pack visuals, with movement provided by InvMove.
inventory-perspective.config.title: Inventory Perspective Settings
inventory-perspective.config.right.toolt: On: player on the left, panel unfolds right. Off: player on the right, panel unfolds left. The recipe book stays on the world panel.
inventory-perspective.config.duration.to: Controls the panel unfolding, folding away, and shoulder camera motion. Set to 0 to disable animation. Configure movement and sneaking in InvMove.
